title: Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid: hidden "yeshua" (ישוע)
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid with a red box around a column of four letters, י ש ו ע, spelling yeshua (ישוע), labelled "yeshua" in red. The same column is boxed in the extracted letters on the right, beside the row מלאך יהוה and the blue diagonal box.

text.text: מ ל א ך י ה ו ה

pictures.description: Grid of Hebrew letters (the text of Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with purple מלאך, coloured letters of יהוה, a blue diagonal box, a green rectangle around one row and a tall red rectangle around a vertical column of four letters.

Extracted letters on the right: the row מלאך יהוה, blue letters ה ש מ and ס, a blue diagonal box, a green box around ש and י, and a tall red box around the column י ש ו ע, with the red word yeshua below.

uncertain: Dense letter grid not copied cell by cell; only the highlighted letters and labels are transcribed.
